title: News Related Reflections on the Synod 2024
text: African Bishops Pleased With Outcome of Synod, Leading Prelate Says October 29, 2024 | Edward Pentin | National Catholic Register Article discusses how African bishops played a key role in fending off efforts to give episcopal conferences greater doctrinal autonomy at the Synod on Synodality.
